entities.summary: Mohammad Hassanzadeh Saberi Akhlaghi is an Iranian professional basketball player. He currently plays for Zob Ahan Isfahan in the Iranian Super League as well as for the Iranian national basketball team, as a forward. He participated in his first major international competition for the Iranian team at the 2010 FIBA World Championship in Turkey. He is 6 ft 7 in (2.01 m) tall.
